violations.text:
- From initial inspection : Intermediate - Menu does not identify which items contain raw or undercooked animal foods covered by the consumer advisory.
Eggs Benedict on menu and cold smoked salmon - From follow-up inspection 2026-08-12: Operator is going to have menus remade

- From initial inspection : Intermediate - Required employee training expired for some employees. To order approved program food safety material, call DBPR contracted provider: Florida Restaurant and Lodging Association (SafeStaff) 866-372-7233. - From follow-up inspection 2026-08-12:

1 Dead roaches on prep table in kitchen
Advised to sanitize table

Advised operator to move
